memory_model: File content uses one reusable 1 MiB buffer per sequential archive operation. Metadata is bounded O(entries+names), not constant memory; index <=64MiB, <=200000 records, record <=32768 characters. EOCD/ZIP64 preflight validates member count/CEN ranges and current available heap before ZipFile allocation; inventory parsing checks headroom and refuses safely after one GC/recheck per pressure occurrence.
qualification_order_note: 190k, long-index and management checks passed before extending only the optional ZIP64 fixture with actual large-file restore and independent SHA256/marker checks. The archive, transaction, transfer and preferences implementations stayed identical. The extended ZIP64 case then passed at 96 MiB.
